title: mdm.employee.account_link.changed.v1
description: An account link's complete current state; the record ID is its UUIDv7. An account is linked to at most one employee at a time; an employee may have several accounts (security 02). Linking and ending are protected operations: the confirmations used travel here, and the authorization member marks each used when it applies this record. Also a record of the watermark stream's record read.

account.description: the account's platform principal (the identity member's)

confirmation.description: the confirmation the link was made with (be.security.confirmation)

end_confirmation.description: the confirmation the link was ended with; null while active (a termination leaves the link: the employee's state says the person left)
